title: Small Data Explainer -- The impact of small data methods in everyday life
abstract: arXiv:2507.11773v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The emergence of breakthrough artificial intelligence (AI) techniques has led to a renewed focus on how small data settings, i.e., settings with limited information, can benefit from such developments. This includes societal issues such as how best to include under-represented groups in data-driven policy and decision making, or the health benefits of assistive technologies. We provide a conceptual overview, clarify the relationship between small data and big data, and identify common themes from exemplary case studies and application areas. Potential solutions are described in a more detailed technical overview of current data analysis and modelling techniques, highlighting contributions from different disciplines, such as knowledge-driven modelling from statistics and data-driven modelling from computer science. translated_title: 小数据解释器——小数据方法在日常生活中的影响
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.11773v2 公告类型：跨领域替换  摘要：突破性人工智能（AI）技术的出现，重新引发了人们对小数据环境（即信息有限的场景）如何受益于这些发展的关注。这包括社会问题，例如如何在数据驱动的政策和决策中最佳地纳入代表性不足的群体，或辅助技术带来的健康益处。我们提供了一个概念性概述，阐明了小数据与大数据之间的关系，并从典型案例研究和应用领域中识别出共同主题。在更详细的技术概述中，我们描述了当前数据分析和建模技术的潜在解决方案，突出了不同学科的贡献，如来自统计学的知识驱动建模和来自计算机科学的数据驱动建模。通过将应用场景、概念贡献和具体技术联系起来，我们强调了当前已可实现的内容。
tldr: 本文系统梳理了小数据方法在AI时代的应用，强调通过跨学科技术整合，解决数据稀缺场景下的社会与健康问题，并展示了其现实可行性。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically reviews small data methods in the AI era, emphasizing cross-disciplinary technique integration to address social and health issues in data-scarce settings, and demonstrates their practical feasibility.
